name: MonarchAssigneePicker
title: AssigneePicker
wrapsNative: MonarchEntityPicker (a .sheet with a List and .searchable) preset for people, with a MonarchButton for Assign to me under the field
summary: A field for assigning one person or several, with avatars, the signed-in person first as (you), an Unassigned row and an Assign to me shortcut.
whenToUse: To set who owns or works on a task, ticket, deal or document, from the workspace's members or a server search.
whenNotToUse: For records other than people, use MonarchEntityPicker. For a role or a permission, use MonarchRolePicker. For inviting people who are not members yet, use the invite-members-dialog recipe.

init(_ label: String, selection: Binding<[String]>, people: [MonarchAssigneePerson], selectedPeople: [MonarchAssigneePerson] = [], currentUserID: String? = nil, helper: String? = nil, error: String? = nil, isRequired: Bool = false, isLoading: Bool = false, showsAssignToMe: Bool = true, minSearchLength: Int = 0, debounce: Duration = .milliseconds(250), labels: MonarchAssigneePickerLabels = MonarchAssigneePickerLabels(), search: (@Sendable (String) async throws -> [MonarchAssigneePerson])? = nil)

struct MonarchAssigneePerson: Identifiable, Sendable { init(id: String, name: String, email: String? = nil, hint: String? = nil, image: Image?, isDisabled: Bool = false, group: String? = nil, status: MonarchPresenceStatus? = nil); init(id: String, name: String, email: String? = nil, hint: String? = nil, url: URL? = nil, isDisabled: Bool = false, group: String? = nil, status: MonarchPresenceStatus? = nil) }

options.name: label
options.description: The visible label, already localised. It names the field and the sheet.

options.name: selection
options.description: The assigned person's id, or nil for nobody; or the ids of several assignees in the order they were assigned.

options.name: people
options.description: The people to choose from. With search, shown until the first search runs.

options.name: selectedPeople
options.description: People for assigned ids that may not be in people, so the field shows their names and avatars.

options.name: currentUserID
options.description: The signed-in person: listed first with (you) after the name, and the target of Assign to me.

options.name: error
options.description: An error message, shown with an icon and announced.

options.name: isRequired
options.description: Shows a mark after the label and adds Required to the hint.

options.name: isLoading
options.description: Shows Loading... in the sheet while people is empty.

options.name: allowsUnassigned
options.description: One assignee only: adds the Unassigned first row that clears the assignee, and shows Unassigned in the empty field.

options.name: showsAssignToMe
options.description: Shows Assign to me under the field while the signed-in person is not assigned.

options.name: minSearchLength
options.description: The shortest text search runs for.

options.name: debounce
options.description: How long to wait after typing before search runs.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replaces Unassigned, the (you) suffix, Assign to me, the Assigned to you announcement, the Assign to... placeholder and the entity picker's strings.

options.name: search
options.description: Looks up people on the app's server as the text is typed; a newer text cancels the older search. Throw to show an error with Try again.

states.name: unassigned
states.description: The field shows Unassigned in the muted text role and Assign to me is offered when there is a signed-in person.

states.name: assigned
states.description: The field shows the person's avatar and name; with the signed-in person, (you) follows the name and Assign to me is hidden.

states.name: several
states.description: The field shows the first avatar and "Ana Silva +1"; the sheet stays open until Done.

states.name: loading
states.description: The sheet shows Loading... while the list is empty, and a progress indicator while a search runs.

states.name: error
states.description: The field border and message use the danger colour, with an icon; the error is announced.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The field uses the disabled roles and Assign to me is hidden.

appearance: The field and sheet are MonarchEntityPicker's: the input background and border, the avatars' generated colours and the accent check mark on assigned rows. Assign to me is a small ghost MonarchButton. Every colour is a theme role, so dark and high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The web AssigneePicker puts Assign to me in the popover's footer; iOS shows it under the field, so the signed-in person can assign themselves without opening the sheet. The web groups people under headings and shows presence dots on the avatars; MonarchEntityPicker has no groups or presence, so the current user is simply listed first and presence can go in hint ("Away"). Several assignees show "Ana Silva +2" (the entity picker's summary) instead of an avatar stack with "3 people". The web's currentUserId and allowUnassigned are currentUserID and allowsUnassigned, following Swift naming. Android plans the same component.
accessibility: The field is the entity picker's button, labelled with the label, valued with every assigned name or None, and with the error, help and Required in its hint.
Avatars are decorative because the name is written beside them.
In the sheet each person is a button read with the name, email and hint; assigned people have the selected trait and a check mark, not colour alone.
Assign to me is a separate button at least 44 points high; after it is used, Assigned to you is announced because the button goes away.
edgeCases: An assigned id that is not in people shows its name only when the person is in selectedPeople; otherwise the raw id is shown.
Disabled people stay in the list but cannot be chosen.
Without currentUserID nobody is marked (you) and Assign to me is not shown.
Long labels and names wrap at every text size.
